# This is straightforward: just connect every vertex to at least one other vertex.
# The simplest solution: create a perfect matching (8 edges covering all 16 vertices).

edges = []
for i in range(0, 16, 2):
    edges.append((i, i + 1))

print("Edges:", edges)
print("Number of edges:", len(edges))

# Verify: every vertex appears at least once
vertices_covered = set()
for u, v in edges:
    vertices_covered.add(u)
    vertices_covered.add(v)

print("Vertices covered:", sorted(vertices_covered))
print("All 16 vertices covered:", len(vertices_covered) == 16)
print("All constraints satisfied (0 <= u < v < 16):", all(0 <= u < v < 16 for u, v in edges))
